description: Move a sandbox deal to its next step. Actions: 'deliver' (seller delivers), 'release' (buyer pays the seller, fee charged), 'refund' (before delivery; buyer gets everything back, no fee). The reply lists the allowed next actions. SANDBOX - simulated, no real funds.

deal_id.description: Sandbox deal id from sandbox_create_deal, e.g. 'sandbox-1a2b3c4d5e6f'.

name: sandbox_advance_deal
title: Sandbox: move a simulated deal forward
